mitigations: TGW Route Table Chaining to Inspection VPC
Centralized Egress VPC with AWS Network Firewall
Domain allowlist filtering via TLS SNI
NAT Gateways in private egress subnets

threats: Compromised pod accessing sensitive services directly

Spoofing.mitigation: AWS VPC CNI ENI binding, EC2 source/dest check, K8s NetworkPolicy

Tampering.risk: Packet sniffing or in-transit tampering between Edge and Core
Tampering.mitigation: mTLS, KMS Secrets Encryption, GWLB inspection

Repudiation.mitigation: VPC Flow Logs on 4 VPCs, TGW Logs, Suricata eve.json, CW Insights

InformationDisclosure.risk: PII/cardholder data leaked to unauthorized C2 destination
InformationDisclosure.mitigation: Centralized AWS Network Firewall egress domain allowlist, Suricata deep packet inspection

DenialOfService.risk: SYN/HTTP floods degrading Edge Ingress or Core API
DenialOfService.mitigation: AWS WAF v2 rate limiting, AWS Shield Standard, GWLB auto-recovery

ElevationOfPrivilege.risk: Frontend container breakout attempting direct RDS 5432 access
ElevationOfPrivilege.mitigation: Isolated Core DB Subnets without direct route from Edge, NetworkPolicy deny-all
